hero.subtitle: Our finance internship teaches the accounting work companies actually do: journals, ledgers, final accounts, GST, TDS and reconciliation. You practise in Excel, Zoho Books and Tally with a 1:1 mentor and finish with a certificate from Icanio Tech School.

answer.question: What is the finance internship at Icanio Tech School?
answer.answer: It is a hands-on accounting and taxation program for commerce students and career switchers. You move through four phases: accounting and financial statements, GST and TDS fundamentals, finance software, then reconciliation and practical application. You work in Excel, Zoho Books and Tally under a 1:1 mentor and earn a certificate. Durations run from 15 days to six months.

sections.heading: What finance and accounts teams do every day
paragraphs: Every business, from a small shop to a listed company, runs on accurate books. The accounts team records each sale and purchase, pays vendors and staff, collects money from customers and closes the books each month. It also files GST returns and deducts TDS correctly, because mistakes bring penalties.

This work never goes away, and it now happens in software. Firms across Tamil Nadu use Tally, Zoho Books and Excel every day. They struggle to find freshers who can post an entry, match a bank statement and explain a GST return without weeks of hand-holding. College syllabi explain the concepts but rarely give that practice.

A finance internship fixes this by putting real transactions in front of you. Our finance internship is built around the tasks a junior accountant handles in the first month of a job, so you walk into interviews with practical answers.

sections.heading: Finance internship curriculum in 4 phases
sections.intro: Each phase of the finance internship ends with a task your mentor checks line by line. Shorter internships go deep on accounting and taxation. Longer ones cover all four phases with more practice sets.

items.label: Phase 1
items.title: Accounting and financial statement basics

Posting journal entries and maintaining the ledger

Payroll, accounts payable and accounts receivable

items.label: Phase 2
items.title: Taxation fundamentals
points: TDS concepts and the common sections that apply to businesses
Computing TDS on payments such as salary, rent and fees
How the TDS filing process works
GST fundamentals: input tax credit and output tax
The basics of filing GST returns

items.label: Phase 3
items.title: Finance tools and software
points: Excel for finance: formulas, lookups and summaries
The Zoho Books workflow for a small business
Recording accounting entries in Zoho Books

Basic accounting entries and reports in Tally

items.label: Phase 4
items.title: Reconciliation and practical application
points: Bank reconciliation: matching books to the bank statement
Vendor reconciliation and clearing differences
Recording a month of accounting transactions end to end
Organising and maintaining financial records
Practical accounting practice, then resume and interview preparation

sections.heading: A typical week in the finance internship
paragraphs: Each week of the finance internship is built around a set of transactions. On the first day your mentor gives you a batch of bills, receipts and bank entries. Your job is to record them correctly and explain each decision.

Midweek is for posting and checking. You enter the vouchers in Tally or Zoho Books, then work out the GST and TDS on each one. You learn to keep a clean trail, because an accountant who cannot show where a number came from will not be trusted with the next one.

At the end of the week you reconcile. You match your books against the bank statement and vendor balances, find the gaps and fix them. In our experience, this weekly close is the most valuable habit a finance internship can build, because it is exactly what employers expect each month.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for the finance internship?
faqs.a: Students and graduates with basic comfort in numbers can apply. The finance internship suits B.Com, BBA and Economics students, CA and CMA aspirants, career switchers and small business owners. You do not need prior work experience. Our team will look at your background and suggest a duration that fits your goals.

faqs.q: Do I need to know Tally before joining?
faqs.a: No. Phase 3 covers Tally and Zoho Books from company setup onwards. If you already know Tally, your mentor will move you faster and add more practice sets. What matters more is a clear grasp of debits and credits, which we cover in Phase 1 before you touch any software.

faqs.q: How long is the finance internship?
faqs.a: You choose the duration, from 15 days up to six months. A short internship covers accounting basics and GST and TDS in depth. Three to six months lets you complete all four phases, practise in Excel, Zoho Books and Tally, and close a full month of books. Our team helps you decide.

faqs.q: Does the finance internship cover GST and TDS?
faqs.a: Yes. Phase 2 is dedicated to taxation. You learn TDS concepts and common sections, compute TDS on everyday payments and see how filing works. On GST you learn input tax credit, output tax and the basics of return filing. You then apply both in your weekly practice sets.

faqs.q: Can I do the finance internship online?
faqs.a: Yes. You can attend offline at our centre, join online, or choose part-time weekday or weekend batches. Hybrid is also possible. Online interns get the same 1:1 mentorship, practice set reviews and certificate as offline interns, so choose whatever fits your college timetable best.

faqs.q: Is this internship useful for CA or CMA students?
faqs.a: Yes. CA and CMA aspirants use it to connect exam concepts with real accounting work. Posting entries, computing TDS and reconciling accounts in software makes the theory easier to remember. It also gives you practical examples to discuss in articleship or job interviews.

faqs.q: Will I get a certificate and placement support?
faqs.a: Every intern who completes the finance internship receives an Icanio Tech School certificate stating the track and duration. The final phase includes resume building and interview practice. Top performers are referred to the Icanio Technologies talent team, and our wider programs have placed over 1,000 students.

faqs.q: Can business owners join to manage their own accounts?
faqs.a: Yes. Entrepreneurs and SME owners join to understand their own books, GST compliance and records. By the end you can read your accounts, spot errors and talk confidently with your auditor or tax consultant. You can also decide whether Tally or Zoho Books suits your business better.

takeaways: The finance internship covers accounting, GST, TDS, finance software and reconciliation in four phases.
You practise on real transactions in Excel, Zoho Books and Tally, reviewed by a 1:1 mentor.
It suits commerce graduates, CA and CMA aspirants, career switchers and business owners.
Durations run from 15 days to six months, offline, online, part time or hybrid.
You finish with an Icanio Tech School certificate, a month of closed books and interview preparation.
conclusion: Accounting skills stay in demand because every business needs clean books and correct taxes. Our finance internship gives you that practice on real transactions, with a mentor who checks every entry.
